title: Death's Chess Game
description: A skeletal Grim Reaper in a hooded cloak hovers above a marble chessboard, manipulating pieces with long skeletal hands. The board features detailed black and white chess pieces, some toppled, with lit candles in pink, white, and blue casting a glow across the scene.
prompt: A skeletal Grim Reaper with glowing white eyes and a hooded cloak floats above an ornate marble chessboard, skeletal hands reaching down to move pieces. The board has detailed black and white chess pieces, some knocked over, with several lit candles in pink, white, and purple hues casting dramatic light. Ornate golden symbols and particles float around the hooded figure against a deep black background, in a dark surreal fantasy style.
